mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, which is associated with rising wages and strong economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0, S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a robust economy with strong supply and demand, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and RSAFS both rise, S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, INDPRO declines but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which is a key driver of corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising RSAFS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST < 1150.0, S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.5, S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
